holds.reason: The separate Heilprin entry and Migdal Oz’s Yerushalmi quotation support the possibility of בריה דרב יוסף. The Yerushalmi text instead has בריה דרבי יוסי, and the exact repair of ברירן and attachment of the final patronymic need edition collation.

evidence.reference: Migdal Oz on Mishneh Torah, Divorce 10:23:3

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: Yerushalmi directly gives R. Neḥemyah bar Mar Ukvan, corroborating the son’s patronymic.

The separate Heilprin entry and Migdal Oz’s Yerushalmi quotation support the possibility of בריה דרב יוסף. The Yerushalmi text instead has בריה דרבי יוסי, and the exact repair of ברירן and attachment of the final patronymic need edition collation.
